## Evidence

     Explain inapplicable prompts rather than silently omitting them. -->

### Behavior and seam
<!-- Before → after, why, the boundary behind which the change lives, and deliberate limits.

### Commands and observations
<!-- Backend claims: exact commands and their real output, revision or CI run.
     Quantitative claims: measured before/after numbers, units, and conditions.
     Changed contracts: redacted requests and actual responses; no credentials or sensitive data. -->

### Visual evidence (only with the human's OK)
<!-- Browser checks and pictures are opt-in: obtain explicit approval before capturing.
     If approved and captured, show the real branch and name each observed surface/state.
     Otherwise state: not verified visually. List unseen states; never claim every state seen if any was not. -->
